# Dave Kowalski — USW Steward (Local 1998)

- **Relationship:** cross-org. Chief steward for **USW Local 1998**, representing hourly workers
  at the Rockford and Toledo plants. Not a Brandt employee in the management sense; the labor
  counterpart.
- **Cadence:** monthly labor-management meeting; ad hoc on grievances.
- **Current issue:** filed a **grievance over mandatory overtime at Rockford** (2026-06) tied to
  the casting shortages; unresolved. Ray wants it settled before it hardens.
- **Contract:** the USW master agreement is **up for renewal in March 2027** — negotiations loom.

## How to work with him
- Fair but firm; values being told things straight and early, not managed.
- Deeply relevant to [Slate](../projects/slate.md): any Toledo footprint action triggers
  **bargaining obligations and WARN-notice** requirements. Keep that confidential until the
  board decides — but Dave is the person those obligations run through.

## Sensitivities
- Trust is fragile after the overtime grievance; a surprise on Toledo would rupture it.
